# Claude SEO subset provenance

Source: https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/claude-seo
Inspected and copied ref: 6be93f45064ffbadced572b5d5c95f55fd263af0
Copyright (c) 2026 agricidaniel. MIT license: see LICENSE in this directory.

Bundled files: agents/seo-technical.md, agents/seo-performance.md,
agents/seo-visual.md, agents/seo-schema.md and scripts/schema_ecommerce_validate.py.
Upstream contents are retained, with final-newline normalization only.

The agent files are reference material, not registered workers or executable
instructions. Their Claude-specific models, plugin paths, install commands,
provider calls and extensions are not activated. The Buildme free SEO protocol
controls execution. Verify changing search-engine guidance against current official
docs rather than treating the snapshot's dates or claims as verified facts.

The Product validator is used only for explicitly scoped Product pages. Its
findings still need context: merchant applicability, jurisdiction and current
Google documentation. Buildme does not bundle the full upstream plugin, Google
SDKs, model routing or paid extensions. The free_seo_audit.py runner is Buildme
code informed by the selected audit checklists, not an upstream runtime clone.
